name: The Unknowns Saga Vol 3: Physical Cosmology
source:
Ie and Thu got the water with the help from Sri, they both landed on earth where water is found everywhere and water for them is much greater than money. Sri told to see Noui the elf like human who knew everything but Noui was busy to help Thu and Ie so they told them where to find water. Not knowing the water contain salt they try heading home but were never told how, Sri send them back home after 24 hours but they were behind the deadline and were forced to give the salt water to the ruler of the 2th dimension. Rock was not happy about the salt water but wonder where the new found water came from, salt is not an element on the 2th dimension.

Thu and Ie escape into the 6th dimension, which Rock is at war with and had a temporary ceasefire. The President, Zoion, heard Ie and Thu story about how there is a world filled with water. Zoion sent his daughter Zixen to have that dimension ally with this one. Back to Rock's world, he used an experimental engine to travel into our world. Dark Unknown has return from his long journey in space and got a new follow to help with his world domination plan. Both enemies have yet to make contact so Sri has time to get every other Unknown and stop the war. One setback is that the usa army thinks it's an invasion from our galaxy, they call on help from ally planets which made things a whole lot worse.
translation:
伊埃和圖在斯里的幫助下取到了水，兩人來到地球，發現這裡到處都是水；對他們而言，水比金錢珍貴得多。斯里讓他們去找精靈般的人類諾伊，後者無所不知，但當時正忙著幫助伊埃和圖，於是只告訴他們哪裡能找到水。他們不知道水裡含鹽，便帶著水踏上回家之路，卻沒人告訴他們該怎麼回去。24小時後，斯里把他們送回家，可他們已經錯過期限，只能把鹽水交給第二維度的統治者。洛克對鹽水很不滿意，卻好奇新水源從何而來，因為鹽並不是第二維度的元素。

圖和伊埃逃入洛克正在交戰、但暫時停火的第六維度。總統佐伊昂聽說兩人的故事，得知存在一個充滿水的世界，便派女兒齊克森前往，讓那個維度與本維度結盟。回到洛克的世界後，他使用實驗性引擎前往我們的世界。黑暗未知者結束漫長的太空旅程歸來，並獲得了一個新夥伴，協助實施統治世界的計畫。兩名敵人尚未接觸，因此斯里有時間召集其他未知者，阻止戰爭。唯一的問題是，美國軍隊以為這是來自我們銀河系的入侵，於是向盟友星球求援，事態因此變得更加糟糕。
